title: Easter Island: The Part Nobody Can Explain
description:
The heads on Easter Island are not heads. Dig beside one and the shoulders come out of the hill, then the arms, then the hands. There is a whole statue under there. That is the famous part. Here is the part that is not. Three hundred and ninety-four of them are still in the hillside they were cut from, and the largest was never finished.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Cold open
00:52 The hillside full of unfinished statues
05:17 A hundred and eleven people
10:28 Twenty-six texts
15:37 The egg
19:57 Outro
